cropWorld.description: Scroll to follow how Agaate supports every growth stage — from seed selection through harvest and market.

01.title: Seed Selection & Soil Prep
01.desc: Genetic purity assessment and bio-enhancement of seed beds.
01.solutionDesc: End-to-end genetic verification and bio-primed seed bed formulation.

hotspots.title: Genetic Screening
hotspots.desc: DNA purity verification to eliminate seed-borne pathogens.

hotspots.title: Mycorrhizal Coating
hotspots.desc: Root-inoculated beneficial fungi for enhanced phosphorus intake.

02.title: Germination & Nursery
02.desc: Climate-controlled nursery sprouting for maximum seedling vigor.
02.solutionDesc: High-tech automated plug tray propagation under optimized light & misting.

hotspots.title: Precision Micro-Climate
hotspots.desc: Automated humidity and thermal regulation for rapid germination.

hotspots.title: Bio-Boost Priming
hotspots.desc: Organic immunity induction against early-stage dampening.

03.title: Transplanting
03.desc: Precision spacing and root-zone biological inoculation.
03.solutionDesc: Expert transplant timing aligned with micro-weather forecasts.

hotspots.title: Root Ball Lock
hotspots.desc: Intact media plugs for instant field soil binding.

hotspots.title: Micro-Inoculation
hotspots.desc: Rhizobacteria flush applied directly to root zones during planting.

04.title: Vegetative Growth
04.desc: Nutrient timing and AI field observation for stress detection.
04.solutionDesc: Multispectral canopy analysis and custom daily fertigation schedules.

hotspots.title: Leaf Stress AI
hotspots.desc: Instant disease diagnosis via camera upload on Agronomist app.

05.title: Crop Protection
05.desc: Targeted bio-protection to suppress pests without chemical overkill.
05.solutionDesc: Botanical bio-pesticides, pheromone traps, and bio-control kits delivered direct.

hotspots.title: Bio-OrganicShield
hotspots.desc: Neem-based extracts & beneficial microbes for sustainable defense.

hotspots.title: Targeted Scouting
hotspots.desc: Pheromone trap monitoring for threshold-based precise spraying.

06.title: Irrigation Management
06.desc: Moisture sensor integration to eliminate over-watering.
06.solutionDesc: Wireless soil moisture sensors linked with automated drip valves.

hotspots.title: Root Telemetry
hotspots.desc: Continuous volumetric water content and electrical conductivity sensing.

07.title: Flowering & Fruit Set
07.desc: Micronutrient boosting to maximize bloom retention.
07.solutionDesc: Chelated zinc, boron, and organic amino acid sprays for maximum pod set.

hotspots.title: Pollen Vigor Boost
hotspots.desc: Boron & calcium foliar application to prevent blossom drop.

hotspots.title: Hormonal Balance
hotspots.desc: Seaweed extracts promoting sink strength toward fruit clusters.

08.title: Harvesting
08.desc: Maturity timing for peak nutritional value and shelf life.
08.solutionDesc: BRIX & firmness testing protocol to hit peak market windows.

hotspots.title: Optical Sugar Index
hotspots.desc: BRIX refractometry to schedule harvest at maximum sweetness.

hotspots.title: Gentle Handling
hotspots.desc: Crate sorting protocol to prevent post-harvest bruising.

09.title: Market Distribution
09.desc: Direct institutional linkage for premium prices at farm gate.
09.solutionDesc: Farm-gate aggregation, cold storage, and direct institutional buyer contracts.

hotspots.title: Cold-Chain Dispatch
hotspots.desc: Pre-cooled transport maintaining farm freshness to buyer hub.

hotspots.title: Transparent Ledger
hotspots.desc: Instant digital weight ticket and direct bank transfer.
